notes.title: 🌟 Extra DLC Release! 🍭
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

The Extra DLC pack is finally here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582580/Artificial_Fashionista__Extra_Collection/

This pack is the biggest one so far, containing [b]9 outfits[/b] with [b]over 70 individual items[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/7654b3a11468d6608bb20e66947902af877eeb2d.png[/img]

Huge thanks to [b]Boonie[/b] for designing the [i]Retrofuture[/i] outfit, and [b]amii[/b] for designing the [i]Butterfly[/i] outfit. I had a lot of fun bringing your visions to life!

[h1]🌟 Steam Deck Verified[/h1]
I also made a bunch of improvements under the hood, which allowed [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] to become [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/fb20d7e782ff9c2a883084555c22b7cbac7dd90f.png[/img]

[h1]🌟 Patch Notes[/h1]
Here's everything that's new and improved in [b]Version 3.2[/b]:
[list]
[*] New Item: Sparkle eyes!
[*] New Aspect Ratio settings!
[*] 3 New Hair Colors: Salmon, Teal, and Platinum Blonde!
[*] Improved the sharpness of images on smaller screens.
[*] Made the hair color palette smaller so it's visible on one screen.
[*] Compatibility for new DLC items.
[*] Search filters now also work on Sets and Backgrounds.
[*] Changed the layering of the Cutout Leotard & Monokini to always be in the back.
[*] Improved layering of various jacket & top combos.
[*] Moved wings further to the back.
[*] Replaced some backgrounds.
[*] Gamepad glyphs are scaled along with the text size setting.
[*] Fixed the display of hair in the "Worn" screen.
[*] Fixed filtering with "AND".
[*] Fixed display errors.[/list]

[h1]🌟 Bundle[/h1]
As always, you can also check out these bundles for an added discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45143/Artificial_Fashionista__Closet_Expansion/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49171/?snr=1_5_9_

[h1]🌟 What's next?[/h1]
Like I previously announced, the Extra DLC pack was the final one, and I'm extremely grateful for how much love you've shown this little game over the past year. I will dedicate myself fully to [i]Artificial Selection[/i] again soon, BUT...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

...Before that happens, I have one last major improvement for [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] in the works:

[b]Challenge Rewards.[/b] That's right! To give you an additional incentive to play challenge mode, I plan to add an exclusive reward item for beating each individual challenge. 

I'm not sure yet if all rewards of a collection should add up to one complete outfit, or if each challenge should give you a specific accessory matching its own theme, so I'm looking forward to hearing your opinions! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments, or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/4337609007230891375/]Outfit Ideas[/url] discussion. I'd be happy to add that niche item you still think is missing!

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Hair Colors & Belts Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

Thanks to a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/4337609007230891375/]great suggestion[/url] in our community, it's time for our first feature update: You can now change Foris' hair color!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/bac4a0a1d6dbef4ee685e2239036ef09e2890f80.png[/img]

I also reorganized the clothes a bit, and added the new "Belt" category:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/dc12605a7fafebb94d2d269d939b4a066aeaa2dc.png[/img]

There are 2 new belts to get you started, and it also means you can now combine the towel with pants or skirts (and not just dresses/swimsuits, like before)!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added hair color options!
[*] Added the "Belt" category with 2 new items!
[*] Reorganized the categories into "Clothes" (containing tops, bottoms, and bodies) and "Cover" (containing jackets and belts).
[*] Added the ability to switch between XBOX and PS4 controller icons, or turn them off completely.
[*] Removed Foris' toes from all slippers. (sorry)
[*] Added a "Reset" button directly to the "Worn" view.
[*] Hopefully fixed an achievement bug.
[/list]

I hope you continue to enjoy [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i], and thank you for your support!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3j6wDw5afC ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/cf4ac127af632c67119b3fc1fb0cc93df126ca94.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Artificial Fashionista release!
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

I'm happy to announce that [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] is now playable on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924880/Artificial_Fashionista

I hope you enjoy hunting all the achievements, and I look forward to seeing your fashionable creations in the community!

It would mean a lot to me if you could leave a review if you enjoyed the game. Every single one helps!
And of course, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/4337608650574954315/]report any bugs[/url] you come across. I want to make sure Artificial Fashionista can be enjoyed by everyone!

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
Unfortunately, there were some delays with the OST, but it will be available as well in a few days:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2935550/Artificial_Fashionista_Soundtrack/

[h1]Related Games[/h1]
[i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] is set in the same world as [i]Artificial Selection[/i]. If you're curious about the other characters, there are hours of content you can catch up on in Artificial Selection's [b]demo[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection

Thank you so much for your support, and have fun!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3j6wDw5afC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/cf4ac127af632c67119b3fc1fb0cc93df126ca94.png[/img][/url]
